methodology.clock: process.hrtime.bigint monotonic wall time around spawnSync
methodology.limitation: No common reliable internal clock API is available. Startup baseline is separate and is never subtracted.
methodology.scheduling: Sequential cases; engine order rotates each warmup/sample; warmups launch fresh processes and are excluded from summaries.
methodology.percentile: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(0.95 * N) - 1]. With fewer than 20 samples p95 is the maximum.
methodology.solxLimits: Default interpreter limits; no unlimited-steps or increased-depth flags.

pathRedaction.rawArtifactPolicy: Raw local artifact is unchanged and ignored by Git.
rules: Rules apply to every string, including embedded logs and escaped paths; Windows separator and forward-slash spellings are covered.
pathRedaction.preserved: All timing values, version information, source/binary/fixture hashes, trial outcomes, and relative paths are unchanged.
pathRedaction.executablePaths: Redacted placeholders document the original command structure; substitute local paths to rerun.
